{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the 6 QA orders have revenue '999,999.99'
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999,999.99']
print("Number of QA orders found:", len(qa_orders))
print("First few QA order IDs:", qa_orders['order_id'].tolist())

# Drop the QA orders
sales_clean = sales[~(sales['revenue'] == '999,999.99')]
print("After removing QA orders, shape:", sales_clean.shape)"}
